evals.prompt: 使用我给的正面、背面和侧面图，通过 Meshy 生成模型，修复后直接交付 Bambu Studio，不需要每一步都问我。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the request as authorization for the normal end-to-end workflow, runs source generation, Blender repair/engineering, Bambu validation, and packaging continuously, and pauses only if a true checkpoint or blocker appears.
expectations: The supplied multiview set is used without repeating a mandatory intake questionnaire.
The Meshy request and credits are recorded and the downloaded source is preserved as immutable.
Source inspection, Blender repair, Bambu validation, and packaging are not split into separate approval turns.
The final response links the package, master, Bambu file, validation evidence, and key render.
No slicing, physical AMS mapping, or printer sending occurs without separate authorization.

evals.prompt: 编辑现有 character.glb：封闭裙底、保留贴图和四肢，做成 120 mm 高的三色 Bambu 3MF 并打包。
evals.expected_output: The agent takes the existing-asset route, skips Meshy and multiview questions, preserves an immutable source, performs the requested Blender edits and print engineering, verifies texture and Bambu color separately, validates the 3MF, and packages the result in one continuous workflow.
expectations: Meshy generation and multiview are skipped because an existing GLB is supplied.
The source is archived and hashed before edits.
Texture preservation and Bambu face-color metadata are checked as separate systems.
Only relevant geometry, scale, color, importer, and archive checks are run.
The final report states topology impact, dimensions, manifold result, and color status.

evals.prompt: 给人物加一个磁吸底座，磁铁尺寸和连接方式你看着办，然后交付打印。
evals.expected_output: The agent performs safe source inspection if possible but pauses once before committing the unspecified precision design, asking a concise bundled question for magnet dimensions, retention method, and mating-side constraints.
expectations: The agent does not invent irreversible magnet dimensions or a mating interface.
All material precision-design questions are grouped into one short checkpoint.
Routine source checks are not presented as separate approval gates.
No slicing or printer sending occurs before explicit physical-print authorization and printer settings.

evals.prompt: 这个模型上一版已经完整验证过，只把眼睛颜色并入肤色，重新导出 Bambu 3MF。
evals.expected_output: The agent reuses the prior geometry audit, verifies only the changed color layer plus final Bambu import and package integrity, and avoids rerunning unrelated multiview, source-generation, BVH, or full-turntable checks.
expectations: The prior unchanged geometry validation is reused.
Historical paint transfer is allowed only after topology compatibility is confirmed.
Eye-region and final paint counts are verified.
Bambu importer and 3MF integrity are checked.
The task completes without artificial phase-end pauses.

evals.prompt: 这个 character.glb 在 Blender 里有颜色，但导入 Bambu 只有一个零件。按坐姿 Meow 的方法把贴图转成五色打印分区，清理色岛后交付 3MF。
evals.expected_output: The agent classifies the source as texture-only rather than falsely claiming it already has print regions, preserves a texture-source GLB, runs Bambu Texture-to-Color Painting, saves the automatic candidate separately, cleans semantic color errors, validates full triangle paint coverage, and delivers the cleaned 3MF with audits.
expectations: The source is audited with inspect_color_partition.py and classified from evidence.
UV display texture and Bambu triangle paint are explained and preserved as separate systems.
The raw Texture-to-Color result is saved as a candidate before semantic cleanup.
Painted and unpainted triangle totals plus per-paint_color counts are validated.
Topology-index paint transfer is used only when vertex and triangle order remain compatible.
The final report states whether conversion actually ran and does not claim physical AMS mapping or slicing.

evals.prompt: 这个修复完成的 textured.glb 要交付三色 Bambu 版本。调用 Meshy 的多色打印流程，GLB 也要保留，不要把普通 3MF 当成分色文件。
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the final textured GLB as the canonical asset, runs the separate Meshy Multi-Color Print task with max_colors 3 after geometry is final, archives the paid task and raw 3MF candidate, validates and cleans it in Bambu Studio, and keeps ordinary generation 3MF distinct from the multicolor result.
expectations: The final textured GLB is retained as the canonical editable and appearance asset.
The separate /openapi/v1/print/multi-color endpoint is used rather than only target_formats 3mf.
The max_colors value, 10-credit cost, task ID, secret-free request, and source hash are recorded.
The raw Meshy multicolor candidate and cleaned Bambu final are saved as separate files.
Color coverage and palette counts are audited and the result is imported by Bambu Studio.
No slicing, physical AMS mapping, or printer sending occurs without separate authorization.

evals.prompt: 给这个已经修好的角色加一个普通圆形打印底座，大小自动适配，别改人物，交付独立 STL 和新的 Blender 文件。
evals.expected_output: The agent skips Meshy, creates a BASE-SPEC, uses the parameterized base builder with safe non-magnetic defaults, protects the character mesh, and delivers a separately printable closed circular base plus a new Blender master and report.
expectations: The existing asset route is used and no Meshy generation or multiview question is introduced.
A circle is created rather than a rounded rectangle, with footprint inferred from reviewed support bounds.
The base remains a separate Print_Base object and the character geometry signature is unchanged.
BASE-SPEC.json and BASE-REPORT.json record dimensions, contact results, and output paths.
The base STL is a closed single-component solid and is checked by the Bambu importer.

evals.prompt: 沿用上一版 Meow：做圆形底座，遮住裙底并连接双手，但两只脚必须悬空；底座后移一点，人物和颜色都不要动。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the accepted master, identifies skirt and hands as support objects and both feet as float objects, builds or semantically sculpts a rear-shifted round base, and proves required contacts and zero foot overlap without modifying character geometry or materials.
expectations: The base footprint is derived from the skirt/hand contact region rather than the whole character bounds.
The base is explicitly circular and shifted rearward to protect suspended feet.
Skirt and hand contacts have non-zero BVH overlap while left and right foot overlap counts are zero.
Protected geometry, UV, and material signatures match before and after.
A side or three-quarter render visibly communicates foot clearance.

evals.prompt: 使用确认好的 12×3 mm 圆磁铁方案给模型加可拆磁吸底座，孔径留 0.2 mm 单边余量，再加两个 18 mm 间距的定位孔。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the supplied physical interface as approved, records it in BASE-SPEC, creates the bottom-opening 12.4×3.3 mm magnet pocket and two locating holes parametrically, checks roof and wall constraints, and continues without asking for already-specified dimensions.
expectations: The 12 mm magnet plus 0.2 mm radial clearance produces a 12.4 mm pocket diameter.
The pocket is bottom-opening, its depth and remaining roof are explicitly reported, and polarity remains an assembly note.
Two locating holes use the specified 18 mm center spacing and remain separate from any mating insert design.
Only base geometry is Boolean-cut; protected source signatures stay unchanged.
Standalone base export, Blender master, BASE-REPORT, and Bambu import evidence are delivered.
